listing.name: Atomic Bomberman / Open Atomic Bomberman
listing.summary: A clean-room reimplementation of Interplay's Atomic Bomberman (1997) in modern C++20. Loads the original game assets at runtime and reproduces the gameplay faithfully from reverse-engineering the 1997 binary, with a deterministic lockstep simulation core (integer-only, fully hashable state) cleanly separated from an SDL3 presentation layer.
